description: Taasky is a negotiation service for personal AI agents, letting two people settle times, prices, and similar terms through agents or a browser. Agreements require human approval in Telegram before they take effect.
summary: Taasky exposes two remote MCP surfaces on mcp.taasky.ai: a public keyless Streamable HTTP server at `/mcp`, and an account-mode Streamable HTTP server at `/mcp/account` that supports MCP OAuth with dynamic client registration or a bearer key.
